content: Major drug contraindications include: Warfarin with thrombocytopenia or active bleeding. ACE inhibitors with bilateral renal artery stenosis. Beta-blockers with severe bradycardia or heart block. Nitrates with phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitors. SSRIs with MAOIs. Fluoroquinolones with aortic aneurysm. Statins with active liver disease. Metformin with severe renal impairment. Sulfonamides with G6PD deficiency. Progestins with history of thromboembolism. Thiazolidinediones with NYHA Class III-IV heart failure. Always review complete medication history before prescribing.
